message.content:
**1) Visual Medium:** Real live-action footage (stunt/practical effects skits, appears to be Zach King-style edited "magic" videos). No game HUD; an iPad displaying a Minecraft-like game appears in frames 6–7, but that's a prop within real footage.

**2) On-screen text (verbatim, repeated on every frame as a centered caption):**
- Frames 1–12 (all): "Kids these days will think this is ai❤️"
- Frame 3: wall number "5246" on the jail cell
- Frame 7: classroom wall poster, partially readable: "…HORNG-MALLIER LIBRARY" (partially legible)
- Small watermark: "imnot.a.iak"-style faint text (illegible, repeated near bottom of several frames)

**3) Visual arc:** A rapid-fire compilation of illusion skits: (1) man running on a beach at sunset under a giant low sun; (2) people at night touching a glowing floor portal; (3–5) an orange-jumpsuit prisoner peeking through cell bars marked "5246," seemingly drawing/erasing the cell wall, then a guard opening the empty cell; (6–7) daytime classroom where a man plays a Minecraft-like game on an iPad over a desk, then reads a book; (8–9) man in school uniform appearing to float/levitate outdoors; (10–12) kids' playroom where a colorful shark mural on the floor becomes a hole people fall into, with toys scattered. Settings shift beach → jail → classroom → outdoors → playroom; palette goes warm sunset/dark night → gray/purple jail → bright classroom whites → colorful mural blues/greens.

**4) Watermark:** A faint repeated small watermark (appears to read something like "imnot.a.iak" / partially legible) near the bottom center of most frames; no clear TikTok username legible.

**5) Story guess:** A compilation of practical-effect "magic" illusions captioned as things that look like AI but are actually real staged video tricks (classic Zach King-style content).
